description: Canonical local-model id selection. Combines CURRENT_MODEL_IDS / STALE_MODEL_IDS from the locked model router with the locked detection record to classify the host into one of MODEL_AVAILABLE / MODEL_NOT_PULLED / PROVIDER_NOT_RUNNING / PROVIDER_NOT_RECOGNIZED / etc. Records the exact operator action (e.g. `ollama pull <id>`) when the canonical model is missing. Pure decision — no model invocation, no pull, no network call.
